title: Allowing users to create custom avatars and sprites: MZ Engine

posts.author: Notchella
posts.body:
As the title says, I want to create a game in which the player can make a completely customisable avatar/ portrait from pre-designated styles, skin tones, hairstyles and eyes. Some threads online have suggested creating all parts as separate images that then get used at the same time to make the avatar. This way would likely cause me some confusion and would be rather messy. I was just wondering if there was another way to do this, or a plugin for MZ that would allow this. The only game I can think of with this kind of design would be the Game Grumps game 'Dream Daddy', where plays can build their avatar.
With this, would there also be a way for this to be reflected in sprites? Again, I could premake the sprites for all combinations, but if there's an easier way or a plugin for this I would greatly appreciate being directed towards this.
Thanks all.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
to answer your questions in more detail:
It is possible, but only with a plugin. and it would be a complex plugin, so I really doubt anyone put in that work for free.
If you had prepared face pictures you could make a selection by eventing, but not if the face picture has to be composed dynamically.
a third option is to create some placeholder and tell the player how to change the placeholder with any other picture file, but that only works as long as the game is unencrypted.

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
